title: Return typed identity-allocation exhaustion without poisoning StateInner
outcome: Exhausted local session/message identity counters refuse allocation through a typed error without wrapping, reusing an identity, panicking or poisoning StateInner; affected local and remote-proxy alias callers preserve their publication/durability contracts.
acceptance: A local session or message identity allocation at the exhausted counter returns a typed error without counter reuse, wraparound, partial publication, panic or StateInner poisoning.
Deterministic tests exercise the boundary through real allocation callers, including remote-proxy alias paths, and show unrelated host operations remain usable after refusal.
Existing durable counter floors, remote-owned message-ID isolation and exact persistence/fence behavior remain intact; required tests and independent review pass.
